summary: This line defines a Makefile variable called DOCKER_PHPQA that constructs a Docker image name by combining a base image path with a PHP version number. When this variable is used later in the Makefile, it will expand to the full image identifier needed to run PHP code quality analysis tools.

explanations.1: The := operator in a Makefile assigns a value to a variable, and the ${PHP_VERSION} syntax retrieves the value of another variable to insert it into the string, so the final image name will be something like 'jakzal/phpqa:php7.4-alpine' if PHP_VERSION is 7.4.
